item.title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation
item.description: BLIP unifies vision-language understanding and generation with a Multimodal mixture of Encoder-Decoder (MED) and bootstraps noisy web data via a Captioning-and-Filtering (CapFilt) module.
